covers: The direct ports a driver maps for the Zilog SCC family, keyed 0x100 plus an index in the order the header declares them: 0x100 dc_ab, 0x101 ab_dc, 0x102 data A, 0x103 data B, 0x104 control A, 0x105 control B, 0x106 zbus, 0x107 interrupt acknowledge. The header declares no cd_ba or ba_cd forms. The register file behind them is in z80scc

entries.name: dc_ab read
entries.description: Universal-bus read: offset bit 1 selects data or control, bit 0 selects channel A or B.
entries.behaviour: Offset bit 0 set is channel A, clear is channel B; bit 1 set reads the receive data (RR8), clear reads the register the pointer selects (RR0 when it is 0). Only Z85X3X types answer. Other types log an error and read 0.

entries.name: dc_ab write
entries.description: Universal-bus write: offset bit 1 selects data or control, bit 0 selects channel A or B.
entries.behaviour: Offset bit 0 set is channel A, clear is channel B; bit 1 set writes the transmit data (WR8), clear writes the register the pointer selects (WR0 when it is 0). Only Z85X3X types answer. Other types log an error and ignore the write.

entries.name: ab_dc read
entries.description: Universal-bus read: offset bit 1 selects channel A or B, bit 0 selects data or control.
entries.behaviour: Offset bit 1 set is channel A, clear is channel B; bit 0 set reads the receive data (RR8), clear reads the register the pointer selects. Only Z85X3X types answer. Other types log an error and read 0.

entries.name: ab_dc write
entries.description: Universal-bus write: offset bit 1 selects channel A or B, bit 0 selects data or control.
entries.behaviour: Offset bit 1 set is channel A, clear is channel B; bit 0 set writes the transmit data (WR8), clear writes the register the pointer selects. Only Z85X3X types answer. Other types log an error and ignore the write.

entries.name: data A read
entries.description: Reads the receive data of channel A, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: The same as RR8 of channel A: pops the receive FIFO and leaves the register pointer alone. Any type answers.

entries.name: data A write
entries.description: Writes the transmit data of channel A, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: The same as WR8 of channel A: queues the byte for transmission and leaves the register pointer alone. Any type answers.

entries.name: data B read
entries.description: Reads the receive data of channel B, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: The same as RR8 of channel B: pops the receive FIFO and leaves the register pointer alone. Any type answers.

entries.name: data B write
entries.description: Writes the transmit data of channel B, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: The same as WR8 of channel B: queues the byte for transmission and leaves the register pointer alone. Any type answers.

entries.name: control A read
entries.description: Reads the control port of channel A, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: Returns the register the shared pointer selects (RR0 when it is 0) and then clears the pointer. Z80X30 types never set the pointer, so this always reads RR0; they use zbus_r for the rest.

entries.name: control A write
entries.description: Writes the control port of channel A, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: Writes the register the shared pointer selects (WR0 when it is 0) and then clears the pointer; a WR0 write sets the pointer for the next access. Z80X30 types never set the pointer, so this always writes WR0.

sources.cites: void ca_w(offs_t offset, uint8_t data) { m_chanA->control_write(data); }

against.line: void ca_w(offs_t offset, uint8_t data) { m_chanA->control_write(data); }

entries.name: control B read
entries.description: Reads the control port of channel B, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: Returns the register the shared pointer selects (RR0 when it is 0) and then clears the pointer. Z80X30 types never set the pointer, so this always reads RR0; they use zbus_r for the rest.

entries.name: control B write
entries.description: Writes the control port of channel B, whatever the offset.
entries.behaviour: Writes the register the shared pointer selects (WR0 when it is 0) and then clears the pointer; a WR0 write sets the pointer for the next access. Z80X30 types never set the pointer, so this always writes WR0.

sources.cites: void cb_w(offs_t offset, uint8_t data) { m_chanB->control_write(data); }

against.line: void cb_w(offs_t offset, uint8_t data) { m_chanB->control_write(data); }

entries.name: zbus read
entries.description: Z-bus read: the 5-bit offset names the channel and the register directly.
entries.behaviour: Offset bit 4 set is channel A and bits 3-0 are the register number (RR0 to RR15); when channel B's WR0 low three bits equal 3 (shift right), bit 0 is the channel and bits 4-1 the register. Only Z80X30 types answer: others log an error and read 0.

entries.name: zbus write
entries.description: Z-bus write: the 5-bit offset names the channel and the register directly.
entries.behaviour: The offset decodes as for zbus read, and register 8 is the transmit data. A write to register 2 or 9 reaches both channels. Only Z80X30 types answer: others log an error and ignore it.

entries.name: interrupt acknowledge
entries.description: Interrupt acknowledge cycle: returns the vector of the interrupt being served.
entries.behaviour: Marks the first pending interrupt as in service and returns channel B's RR2 vector, including status bits when WR9 bit 0 is set. With WR9 bit 1 set, or with no interrupt pending, it returns the default vector of the CPU named by set_cputag, or -1 when none was named.
